# Udhaya Kumar — Staff Backend Engineer

Staff Backend Engineer with 13+ years building production systems and data platforms. Specializes in real-time CDC infrastructure, data warehousing, identity resolution, and scaling backend systems across 200+ merchants.

## Key work

- **Data platforms**: CDC pipelines with Debezium, warehouse consolidation (BigQuery, ClickHouse), tiered freshness for real-time and batch consumers
- **Systems architecture**: Deterministic identity resolution, segmentation engines, recommendation systems, production incident recovery
- **Scaling**: multi-region serving, latency optimization, cost reduction, team growth (4 → 7 engineers)
